      "partial_result": "# Verdict: REJECT the fixed all-bank log-NCA recipe (T=.01, outer \u00d78)\n\nThis was read-only: no repo edits, jobs, consultations or quality reads. The only thing I wrote was a memory note outside the repo.\n\n## Facts from source and existing receipts\n\n- **F1. Both rank branches must be replaced, not just `valid_rank`.** `train_pe_native_valid_anchor.py:57` sets `rank_active` per batch to \"every product in the batch has more than one image\".\n  - If true, `pe_large_coverage.py:116` runs full-batch `member_bank_rank_loss`, which is SmoothAP.\n  - If false, `pe_native_valid_anchor.valid_rank` runs, also SmoothAP.\n  - Patching only `valid_rank`, as the recipe says, would give a mixture arm: SmoothAP on singleton-free batches, NCA on the rest.\n- **F2. The \".01 inherited\" label is nominal.** `smooth_ap_bank_loss` (`deployed_code_rank.py:94`) compares pairs as \u03c3((s_n\u2212s_p)\u00b72/T), a slope of 200. That equals a two-way softmax at T=.005, so NCA at T=.01 is half as sharp. Positives are every other fit image of the same product (`member_bank_positive_ordinals`, `allow_singletons=True`). Candidates are the whole fit bank except self.\n- **F3. The clip binds every step.** From `late-dense-v1/control-179032-v1.log` (same corrected source family):\n\n  | Quantity | Median | Range |\n  |---|---|---|\n  | CE | .226 | .064\u2013.810 |\n  | SmoothAP rank | .0085 | max .031 |\n  | Pre-clip gradient norm | 19.5 | 7.56\u201331.9 |\n\n  With a global clip at 1, the \u00d78 coefficient only sets the rank term's share of the update direction.\n- **F4. The fit error set is small.** On the half-arm fit bank, 259 of 13,283 rows (1.95%, 214 products) have their best positive below the nearest negative. That census was not run on the cc58377f bank.\n- **F5. Half the role-split misses are invisible to a full-inventory event.** In the pose-gap screen (older seed-179026 true-freeze checkpoint):\n  - R@1 is 98.33% with every image as a candidate, and 97.62% when only gallery-role images count.\n  - 78 of the 151 role-split misses were hits when every image counted; their winning positive sat in the query role.\n  - Removing negatives rescued another 33 queries.\n- **F6. The gate panel and official are role-split events.** Held roles: per product, order images by SHA-256 of the relative path, assign round(n/2) to gallery (bounded to [1, n\u22121]), the rest to query (`inshop_asymmetric_proxy_gate_2026-09-26.md:5`). Training positives use the full inventory instead.\n- **F7. Prior adjacent results; no exact duplicate found.**\n  - CUB `local_nca` lost 13.7pp. That was a different regime: T=.1, top-16 negatives, its own memory, and a uniform positive softmax.\n  - The worst-positive softplus hinge at 100 updates was null: role-split R@1 +0.094pp, all-candidates R@1 \u22120.040pp, mAP \u2212.0004.\n  - Hard-anchor sampling was killed at feasibility (only 259 hard rows).\n  - Late-dense at 100 updates measured \u22120.205pp R@1, with a confidence interval excluding 0. So the 100-update instrument can resolve effects of about 0.2pp.\n- **F8. The existing `_local_nca_loss` is not a safe reuse.** At `image_end_to_end.py:7461` it excludes self by diagonal position (`valid_mask[diag,diag]`) and marks positives by label equality. Against a bank indexed by fit ordinal it would exclude bank rows 0\u201315 and keep the anchor's own stale bank row as a positive with cosine \u22481. The loss would be \u22480 everywhere. It also uses top-16 negatives and averages over kept anchors only, not the full-batch denominator.
